usageNotes: Use this endpoint to discover the available sub-resources under the /config/access/tfa namespace in Proxmox Datacenter Manager. It acts as a directory index for TFA configuration — call it to enumerate which TFA-related child endpoints are exposed before drilling into a specific one. No elevated privileges are required; any authenticated user or API token can call it.
tips: No query parameters are accepted — the response is a fixed directory listing.
Because permissions are 'user: all', this is safe to use with any valid API token for capability discovery.
Use the returned directory entries to identify which /config/access/tfa/* endpoints are available before querying or modifying TFA settings.
